title: Equivariant locally constant torsor functions form a sheaf
statement: Let V be any scheme, ell a natural number, P a finite group, c:Y -> V a finite etale ULift(P)-torsor, and N a ZMod ell representation of P. The equivariant locally constant module presheaf of [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module], after coefficient restriction along ULift.ringEquiv:ULift(ZMod ell) -> ZMod ell, is a sheaf on the small etale site of V. No connectedness, primality, or finite generation is needed.

source.place: Tags 0DV5 (3), 0DV6 and 0A3R, proof identifying the restricted representation; sites.tex Tags 04TR and 04TS (gluing sheaves and mapping property), with module operations as in 0DV5 (3); explicit section-evaluation implementation of the fixed-torsor argument

proof.text: Give N the discrete topology. The existing small-etale continuous function sheaf on Y, precomposed with the continuous base-change functor along c, gives the sheaf H(W)=C(W times_V Y,N). Forgetting abelian groups preserves the sheaf property. This is functionPresheaf_isSheaf, using Scheme.Etale.continuousMapSheaf and Etale.isContinuous_overPullback.

Define the subfunctor G of H by equivariance. Restriction commutes with the deck action by pullback.hom_ext. To show that equivariance is local, compare the two continuous functions s composed with a deck action and rho(g) composed with s. They agree on a covering sieve on which s is equivariant; separatedness of H gives their equality globally. Mathlib Subfunctor.isSheaf_iff now proves G is a sheaf.

For discrete N, locally constant functions and continuous functions are inverse pointwise constructions. They identify the underlying presheaf of the scalar-restricted equivariant module presheaf with G. Naturality follows by comparing the pullback restriction maps with pullback.hom_ext. Transport the sheaf property through this natural isomorphism and reflect it through the forgetful functor from modules, with explicit universe-shrunk limit instances.

theorem Scheme.GaloisCover.equivariantModulePresheaf_isSheaf
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (ℓ : ℕ) (P : Type u) [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) (N : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
      (c.equivariantModulePresheaf ℓ N ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) →+* ZMod ℓ))
